title: Send cash. Send stocks.
summary: Send USDC, SOL, and supported tokenized stocks to another Solana wallet, with the recipient, amount, and fees reviewed before you approve. Local preview shown with sample balances.

items.title: Withdraw without leaving your page
items.description: Open Withdraw from your account menu, choose what to send, and enter the receiving Solana wallet.

items.title: Your stock tokens can move too
items.description: Send unlocked stock tokens you hold, including fractional shares. Oren keeps the exact token variant and handles xStocks share adjustments.

items.title: Review the full transfer
items.description: Check the receiving address, quantity, network fee, and any receiving token-account cost before approving.

items.title: Keep track of pending withdrawals
items.description: Reopen a pending withdrawal to check its status. If submission needs another attempt, Oren retries the same signed transfer.

screenshots.alt: Oren withdrawal modal with Tesla xStock selected and a fractional-share transfer entered, shown locally with illustrative balances and addresses.
